'''Customs troopers''' were specialized [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] that served [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. They wore [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vests]] and were armed with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="SL2">{{JournalCite|2|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>
